# Day Cluster Support

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

The supporting notes within a Day Cluster that assist the core notes, such as DayActions and DayLinks.

## Scope note

Holds auxiliary tracking (tasks, references) rather than the primary daily narrative held in DayClusterCore.
